title: match shopify admin voice
name: Match shopify admin voice
rule: Match Shopify admin voice; tone shifts (errors more direct than onboarding tips).
pass_when: App copy matches admin voice; errors are more direct than onboarding tips.
fail_when: Off-admin voice, or the same chipper onboarding tone on errors.
overview: Match Shopify admin voice; make errors more direct than onboarding tips.
apply_when: Writing app copy, errors, and onboarding tips in Shopify admin.
not_when: Off-admin voice or chipper onboarding tone on error messages.
agent_hint: Match admin voice; keep errors more direct than onboarding tip tone.
description: Match Shopify admin voice, with tone that shifts by moment: errors are more direct than onboarding tips. Pass when app copy matches admin voice and errors stay more direct than tip tone. Fail for off-admin voice, or when the same chipper onboarding tone is used on error messages that need clearer urgency and directness for recovery.
